# Hash-pinned install set for the LiteLLM proxy in .github/workflows/litellm-gateway.yml.
#
# Direct requirements: litellm[proxy]==1.83.7 prisma==0.11.0
#   opentelemetry-api==1.44.0 opentelemetry-sdk==1.44.0
#   opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.44.0
#   (prisma is LiteLLM's own pin for its proxy database client, and the
#   OpenTelemetry packages are what its "otel" callback imports. The [proxy]
#   extra pulls in neither: without prisma the proxy will not start with
#   virtual keys and teams, and without OpenTelemetry the callback logs a
#   non-blocking import error and exports nothing. The OpenTelemetry versions
#   are the ones the local end-to-end run used.)
#
# Installed into its OWN virtualenv in that job, never next to clawmetry:
# LiteLLM pins its own fastapi / pydantic / openai stack, and the job is about
# talking to LiteLLM over the wire, not importing it.
#
# Hash-locked because LiteLLM has had compromised releases on PyPI; an exact
# version without hashes would still trust whatever the index serves.
# `prisma generate` in the job downloads Prisma's engine binaries, which this
# file cannot pin.
#
# Regenerate: put the direct requirements above in ll.in, then
#   uv pip compile ll.in --generate-hashes --python-version 3.11 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -o ci-litellm-proxy.txt
